title: Finite Cartier pole reduction agrees with site comparison
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, $r\geq1$, $R=\mathbf Z/\ell^r\mathbf Z$, and a finite commutative $R$-algebra $\Lambda$. Let $Z$ be a scheme on which $\ell$ is invertible and $i:D\hookrightarrow Z$ an effective Cartier divisor [def-pc-divisor-line-bundle]. Write $
u_T:T_{\mathrm{proet}}	o T_{\mathrm{et}}$ for the site comparison [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], use its exact derived inverse image, applied termwise [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback] (on integral coefficients this is the exact inverse image of $\mathbf Z$-module sheaves of [sk-thm-pe-direct-image-comparison] with $\Lambda=\mathbf Z$), and the ordinary module derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. On $Z_{\mathrm{et}}$, take the Cartier pole extension $0	o\mathbf G_{m,\mathrm{et}}	o\mathcal M_D	o i_{\mathrm{et},*}\mathbf Z_D	o0$ (etale direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]), whose sections locally have the form $ut^{-a}$ for a regular equation $t$, and whose quotient sends $t^{-1}$ to $+1$. Its connecting morphism $ eta_{\mathrm{et}}$ is the last arrow of its short-exact-sequence triangle [lem-sf-derived-ses-triangle], using the negative cone projection convention of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Put $B=
u_Z^{-1}\mathbf G_{m,\mathrm{et}}$, $G(U)=\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)^	imes$, and let $a:B	o G$ be the units comparison adjoint to restriction on etale objects. Identify $
u_Z^{-1}i_{\mathrm{et},*}\mathbf Z_D$ with $F=i_{\mathrm{proet},*}\mathbf Z_D$ (pro-etale module direct image [def-weil-proetale-module-direct-image]) by the degree-zero adjunction-mate comparison of [sk-thm-pe-direct-image-comparison], and set $ eta=a[1]
u_Z^{-1} eta_{\mathrm{et}}:F	o G[1]$.

For $L_R=-\otimes^L_{\mathbf Z_Z}R_Z$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], identify $L_R(F)$ with $i_*R_D$ by the quotient map and $L_R(G)$ with $\mu_{\ell^r,\mathrm{proet}}[1]$ by the Kummer normalization of [lem-sfb-divisible-extension-derived-reduction]: the scalar-extension unit becomes the Kummer connecting morphism. Under the roots comparison $
u_Z^{-1}\mu_{\ell^r,\mathrm{et}}\xrightarrow{\sim}\mu_{\ell^r,\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-pur-roots-of-unity-sheaf, lem-asd-finite-etale-twist-line] and the supported-constant comparison, the entire morphism $L_R( eta)$ equals the comparison pullback of $L_R( eta_{\mathrm{et}})$. After derived extension to $\Lambda$, and the canonical supported-source and finite-Tate-line identifications, this morphism is precisely $c_D:i_*\Lambda_D	o\Lambda_Z(1)[2]$ of [sk-lem-geo-cartier]. These are the canonical adjunction-mate source and roots-induced target identifications, so the equality includes the supported restriction map and positive Kummer sign, not only the composite with $\Lambda_Z	o i_*\Lambda_D$.
